post.description:
Add Reader using an IP address by providing the necessary information in the request body.

In order for this service to execute properly the Reader must be reachable and not reserved by any other edge.
If the driver does not need authentication to be able to connect to the Reader, then there is no need to add the authentication property.

Add Reader using an IP and MAC address by providing the necessary information in the request body.

Using this service the Reader can be added even if it is unreachable.
If the driver does not need authentication to be able to connect to the Reader, then there is no need to add the authentication property.

Enable Reader by UID.
In order for this service to execute properly the reader must be reachable and not reserved by any other edge.
If the driver does not need authentication to be able to connect to the Reader, then there is no need to add the authentication property.

Reboot Reader by UID.
In order for this service to execute properly the Reader must be reachable and not reserved by any other edge.
If the driver does not need authentication to be able to connect to the Reader, then there is no need to add the authentication property.
Execute a Reader's command by providing its UID, vendor and the command in the request body.
Delete specific Readers according to the vendor and UID provided in the request body.
Restore the edge settings plus all the cluster's properties ordered by creation date of each property.
Set the Reader properties according to the values provided in the request body.
Readers discovered on the network will show up on EMC.
